s: Normal menjaga real-time dan boleh melewatkan cache jika decoder tertinggal. Real-time Mengejar juga menjaga playhead/audio real-time, tetapi pre-render mempertahankan antrean frame berurutan di belakang playhead dan mengejar tanpa sengaja membuat celah. Semi Kuat memberi frame yang hilang waktu singkat untuk masuk cache sehingga playback boleh sedikit melambat. Kuat menunggu setiap frame. Tombol Rekam Pre-render tetap memaksa Mode Kuat selama aktif.
en: Normal keeps real time and may skip the cache when the decoder falls behind. Real-time Catch-up also keeps the playhead/audio in real time, but pre-render keeps a sequential frame queue behind the playhead and catches up without accidentally creating gaps. Semi Strong gives a missing frame a short time to enter the cache so playback may slow slightly. Strong waits for every frame. The Pre-render Record button keeps forcing Strong Mode while it is active.

s: Urutan kartu efek piksel menentukan pemrosesan piksel. Kontrol Expression mengevaluasi transform setelah keyframe, tanpa pass shader. Particular dan Transform Motion Blur berada pada tahap komposisi akhir. Efek yang belum tersedia tetap disimpan saat diimpor.
en: The order of the pixel effect cards determines pixel processing. Expression controls evaluate the transform after keyframes, without a shader pass. Particular and Transform Motion Blur sit at the final compositing stage. Effects that are not available yet are still kept when imported.

s: Null 2D merekam proyeksi kamera utama, bukan Editor Camera. Setelah kamera/transform video berubah, buat Null 2D baru. Null 3D tetap mengikuti perubahan transform bidang video. Kedalaman objek di dalam rekaman tidak direkonstruksi oleh Null bidang video.
en: Null 2D records the main camera projection, not the Editor Camera. After the camera or the video transform changes, create a new Null 2D. Null 3D keeps following changes to the video plane transform. Object depth inside the footage is not reconstructed by a video-plane Null.

s: Adaptive N-Source mempertahankan sebanyak mungkin video pada decoder native. Saat beban melewati kapasitas terukur, Open Motion menurunkan cadence upload texture layer berprioritas rendah secara progresif sebelum memakai fallback WebCodecs.
en: Adaptive N-Source keeps as many videos as possible on the native decoder. When load exceeds the measured capacity, Open Motion progressively lowers the texture upload cadence of low-priority layers before falling back to WebCodecs.

s: Umur memakai satu segmen yang tersambung, bukan gabungan titik sebelum/sesudah hilang. Awal–akhir layer harus mencakup awal dan frame akhir layer (toleransi akhir satu frame proyek), bukan hanya rentang analisis pendek.
en: Lifetime uses one connected segment, not a union of points before and after a loss. The start and end of the layer must cover the first and last frame of the layer (end tolerance of one project frame), not just a short analysis range.

s: Mode Otomatis hanya dapat memeriksa salinan yang pernah disimpan Open Motion di data proyek atau penyimpanan browser. Browser tidak dapat menelusuri seluruh penyimpanan perangkat tanpa pilihan file dari pengguna.
en: Automatic mode can only check copies that Open Motion has saved in project data or browser storage. A browser cannot scan the whole device storage without a file chosen by the user.

s: Lacak fitur dari video asli, baik footage 2D maupun footage di Ruang 3D. Pilih tanda + untuk membuat Null dengan keyframe yang bisa diedit. Titik pada footage 3D mengikuti perspektif kamera.
en: Track features from the original video, both 2D footage and footage in 3D Space. Choose the + sign to create a Null with editable keyframes. Points on 3D footage follow the camera perspective.

s: Layer gambar, video, teks, dan shape yang nonaktif tetap dirender sebagai komposit 2D dan tidak dipengaruhi kamera. Saat diaktifkan, layer menjadi textured plane 3D dengan depth test WebGL.
en: Image, video, text and shape layers that are disabled are still rendered as a 2D composite and are not affected by the camera. When enabled, the layer becomes a 3D textured plane with WebGL depth testing.
